svg.text: Figure 4.12c Entity Relationship Diagram, Part 3 of 4
Orders and costing: custom furniture orders from quote to payment, production, completion and refund
reference: table drawn in full in another part
Types: ts = timestamptz, num = numeric, int = integer. Each line runs from a foreign key column (crow’s foot) to the table it references (bar), always to that table’s primary key.
order_costings.order_id is both its primary key and a foreign key to design_orders.id, so every order has at most one costing sheet.
